xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4305: Composer marks long or queued messages "Not found in transcript": parser drops Claude Code's <pasted_content> wrapper as a system injection

plan.title: Composer marks long or queued messages "Not found in transcript": parser drops Claude Code's <pasted_content> wrapper as a system injection
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Claude Code records a long composer paste as <pasted_content id="N">…</pasted_content id="N"> in both landed user records and queued_command prompts. The parser's renderableUserText() drops the queued form entirely (isSystemInjection() rejects any text starting with '<') and renders the landed form (leading \n\n dodges the check) with the tags still inside its text. The composer's reconcileComposerEchoes() compares exact text, so both forms fail to match; a queued prompt whose image references Claude Code joined with a space, or that merges adjacent content, also fails. After 4 idle minutes the bubble turns red ('Not found in transcript') and invites a Resend that duplicates the message. The server landing probe (probeTranscriptSince) already matches all these shapes through whitespace-collapsed includes(); the red state comes from parser output plus the frontend matcher.
narratives.Proposal: Add src/lib/pasted-content.ts (hasPastedContentWrapper, stripPastedContentWrappers) with the exact contract in PRD D2. renderableUserText() unwraps pasted_content per PRD D3 so landed and queued wrapped messages render as the operator's text. probeTranscriptSince() and extractSidechainHumanText() strip the wrapper before prefix checks (hygiene; matching semantics unchanged) and gain regression fixtures. reconcileComposerEchoes() compares whitespace-collapsed text and adds a bounded containment pass (PRD D5) so merged queued prompts clear their bubbles. docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md documents the unwrap, the matching rules, and why delivery keeps bracketed paste.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing composer delivery (tmux paste-buffer -p, Herdr pane.send_text / agent.prompt) to avoid Claude Code's paste wrapper
- Changing how the agent perceives <pasted_content> text (Claude Code labels it as pasted third-party text)
- Fixing src/lib/conversations/summary-fork.ts:478, which drops user text starting with '<' from handoff summaries (follow-up issue)
- Rewriting probeTranscriptSince() matching: MATCH_PREFIX_CHARS, includes() semantics, and byte-range reading stay as they are
- Editing src/dashboard/server/services/conversation/parser.ts (it already routes all user text through renderableUserText)
- Changing the 4-minute TURN_STALL_MS timer, composer receipts, or Resend semantics
- Non-Claude harness parsers (Pi, Codex, ACP) and the OKF knowledge bundle in ../overdeck-knowledge

autoDecisions.summary: Resolve the issue's delivery checkpoint in planning: keep bracketed-paste delivery and document why instead of changing it.
autoDecisions.rationale: Every delivery path pastes (tmux paste-buffer -p at src/lib/tmux.ts:1061/1099; Herdr send_text wrapped in \x1b[200~ at steer-keys.ts:44; Herdr agent.prompt produced the wrapped record 3401 in conv 2972), and steer-keys.ts:33-35 records that raw bytes submit a multi-line message at its first newline. Avoiding the wrapper would break multi-line composer messages. The issue's own fallback is 'if not, document why'.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the unwrap helper in a new src/lib/pasted-content.ts module shared by the dashboard parser filter and the lib landing probe.
autoDecisions.rationale: transcript-landing.ts must not import from src/dashboard (its comment at :370-374); one helper keeps the two consumers on one regex contract.

autoDecisions.summary: Strip wrappers anywhere in the text (not only a whole-text wrapper), accept closing tags with or without an id, and skip isSystemInjection on the unwrapped operator text; a text that starts with a real system injection stays hidden even if it quotes a paste.
autoDecisions.rationale: Real records carry `</pasted_content id="N">` closers and typed-prefix-plus-paste is plausible; an operator paste can legitimately start with '<' (XML/HTML), and hiding it would recreate the bug.

autoDecisions.summary: Add a bounded containment pass to the composer echo matcher, in addition to whitespace-collapsed exact and joined-run matching.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue reports a one-image bubble whose queued record held two images plus text; only containment clears that. The server probe already accepts containment, so the frontend now agrees with it. Bounds (created-at order, baseline ids, clientMessageId equality, non-empty text) keep false positives to the case of a truly lost message whose full text reappears inside a later message, which is accepted and recorded as a hazard.

autoDecisions.summary: Leave summary-fork.ts's startsWith('<') filter out of scope.
autoDecisions.rationale: Same root cause but a different surface (handoff summaries) with its own tests; the issue scopes the composer and timeline. Recorded in NonGoals and the codebase map concerns so a follow-up can pick it up.

metadata.sizeJustification: Five small items across 4 code subsystems (lib helper, dashboard parser filter, lib landing probe, frontend composer) plus 1 doc; well under the 25-file / 6-subsystem limits.

Composer echo matcher collapses whitespace and clears bubbles contained in merged queued prompts

verify_commands: cd src/dashboard/frontend && npx vitest run --configLoader runner src/lib/__tests__/composerEchoes.test.ts src/components/chat/__tests__/MessagesTimeline.test.tsx
expected_outputs: composerEchoes.test.ts (existing PAN-4247 tests plus new PAN-4305 tests) and MessagesTimeline.test.tsx pass

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/composerEchoes.ts: (D4) make pass 1 (1:1) and pass 2 (joined runs) compare with normalizeWs instead of normalizeText; remove normalizeText if unused. (D5) After pass 2 and before the subagent pass, add a containment pass over still-unmatched entries (optimistic plus failed kind==='prompt'), in createdAt order: an entry matches a message when message.role==='user', message.id is not in the entry's echoBaselineIds, message.id is not in `used` unless this containment pass claimed it, not (both have clientMessageId), Date.parse(message.createdAt) >= Date.parse(entry.createdAt), normalizeWs(entry.text) is non-empty, and normalizeWs(message.text).includes(normalizeWs(entry.text)). One message may clear several entries; add claimed ids to `used`. Remove matched entries from optimistic and failed. Update the early-return condition so an unchanged state is still returned by identity, and update the doc comment to describe four passes. Add describe('reconcileComposerEchoes pasted and merged prompts (PAN-4305)') with the 7 cases listed in PRD WI-4. The existing PAN-4247 tests in composerEchoes.test.ts must keep passing unmodified. UAT for ac5 follows continue.json H6.

narrative.Action: In docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md, extend the 'HTTP acceptance and transcript confirmation are distinct' bullet under **Conversation loading and delivery** (search for `moves to the outbox as "Not found in transcript"`). Add: (1) Claude Code records a long composer paste as `<pasted_content id="N">…</pasted_content id="N">` in landed and queued records; renderableUserText() and the landing probe strip it through src/lib/pasted-content.ts, so the timeline shows the operator's text. (2) Echo matching collapses whitespace and also clears a bubble whose full text is contained in a later user record (a merged queued prompt); the red state appears only when no landed or queued record matches. (3) Delivery keeps bracketed paste because raw typed bytes submit a multi-line message at its first newline, so the agent sees long composer messages inside <pasted_content>, which Claude Code labels as pasted text — a known, accepted side effect.
